fields.System.Title: RPL-204 — Prevent duplicate open tasks
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want one task per shortage, so that my task list is not
twenty copies of the same job.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an open task already exists for a pick location, then no second task is created,
  • regardless of how many times the trigger fires.
  • - Given the rule, then it is enforced by a unique database constraint on
  • (location_id, status) for open statuses — not by a check-then-insert.
  • - Given fifty trigger events fired rapidly for one location, then exactly one task
  • exists.
  • - Given the open task completes and the location is still below minimum, then a new task
  • can be created.
  • - Given both a reactive and a demand-driven trigger for the same location, then still
  • only one task exists.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment |
| Tables | replen_task |
| Risks | Task storm ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency (mandatory: rapid repeated triggers) |
